source_summary: Vertical monochrome Chinese landscape with layered mountains, river/lake spaces, rocky banks, pines, leafless trees, small pavilion compounds, and a low bridge. Motifs exclude calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture.

motifs.name: central_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large central upper mountain peak and its descending ridges, including the clustered dark tree marks on the summit and the ink-textured rock faces. Avoid the separate pale peaks to the left and right where possible.
must_preserve: vertical ink strokes down the main cliff face
dry-brush ridge contours
small dotted tree clusters on the summit
dark pine marks on the mid-slope
soft pale wash transitions along the mountain shoulders

motifs.name: left_upper_lake_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet upper-left water inlet with low sandy banks, small rocks, reeds, and sparse shoreline trees. Do not include the central village buildings below or the main mountain above.
must_preserve: flat pale water wash
thin horizontal shoreline strokes
tiny stippled reeds and grasses
small rounded rocks at the water edge
delicate bare branch linework

motifs.name: right_cliff_pine_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-right rocky cliff with a gnarled pine and the small pavilion tucked behind it. Include the adjoining shrub texture and roof geometry, but exclude the large central mountain and lower village.
must_preserve: angular pavilion roof lines
dark window and wall strokes
gnarled pine trunk curve
clustered pine-needle dots
striated rock texture on the cliff face
small shrub stippling around the path

motifs.name: middle_village_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the middle village cluster set among bare trees and shrubs beside the water, including the two visible roofed structures and surrounding low banks. Avoid the large right cliff and upper lake beyond.
must_preserve: straight roof eaves and dark beam lines
small wall and window accents
thin leafless tree branches rising around the houses
dotted shrubs and hedge marks
curving ground contour lines
subtle warm tan wash on the buildings

motifs.name: right_bank_house_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-lower right riverside house compound with nearby leafless trees, sloped bank, shrubs, and small rocks. Exclude the water expanse to the left except for the immediate shoreline edge.
must_preserve: rectangular house geometry with balcony-like dark railing strokes
sloped roof and wall outlines
tall leafless tree trunks and branching ink lines
stippled bushes along the bank
small rock clusters and path strokes
pale hillside wash behind the building

motifs.name: central_bridge_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the low arched bridge crossing the narrow water channel, together with the two leaning pines beside it and the immediate bridge abutments. Avoid the larger left cliff and right rocky hillside as much as possible.
must_preserve: single curved bridge deck line
thin vertical bridge supports
leaning pine trunks
dense needle clusters rendered as dark stippled sprays
small grassy bank marks around the bridge feet
pale water wash beneath the span

motifs.name: left_foreground_cliff_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent left foreground cliff with the large old pine leaning over the water and the lower leafless trunks on the cliff face. Exclude the calligraphy and seal lower left.
must_preserve: rugged vertical cliff contour strokes
twisted pine trunk and exposed branch structure
dense rounded pine-needle clusters
dry-brush rock creases
small shrubs at the cliff base
contrasting dark ink accents against pale rock wash

motifs.name: lower_foreground_bank_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground sloping bank with the large leafless tree spreading across the center, nearby boulders, shrubs, and shoreline contours. Do not include the signature or red seal at the far lower left.
must_preserve: forking bare branch linework
dark knotted trunk base
rounded boulder outlines and texture dots
stippled shrubs along the slope
curving shoreline and ground contour strokes
soft pale wash defining the bank edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
